gold_metrics_note: macro_f1 corrected post-hoc (was 0.6421 in the original training run) -- the original evaluate_on_gold() call passed labels=LABELS (all 40 classes) to sklearn's f1_score, which forces the 9 classes with zero examples in the 498-row gold set to contribute a guaranteed 0 to the macro average. Rung 1 (eval_models_on_gold.py) and Rung 3 (train_llm_lora.py) both omit `labels=` and only average over classes actually appearing in y_true/y_pred, so the original 0.6421 was not comparable to their macro_f1 numbers. Fixed in scripts/train_deberta.py and recomputed against the saved checkpoint via scripts/eval_checkpoint_deberta.py -- see output/rung2_percategory_and_novel_full_62k_plus_rare.json and WRITEUP.md section 4.
